gemini.title: Delivery Point
gemini.abstract: Delivery Point is part of AddressBase Premium, published by Ordnance Survey. It represents delivery point features using geometry geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by Ordnance Survey as part of AddressBase Premium. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
